method: 1 次基线生成 + 3 次编辑。三次编辑均 referenced_image_paths 指向完全相同的 baseline 文件。无重试、无挑选、无链式编辑、无后处理、无裁切或缩放。
evidenceNote: 完整提示词逐字保留；工具本地文件路径在本发布记录中归一为相对文件名，以 SHA-256 对照实际文件。日期显示使用 Asia/Shanghai，调用时间保留 UTC。

source.prompt: Create one square photorealistic baseline portrait for an image-edit research comparison. The person is explicitly a synthetic, fictional adult East Asian man, approximately 35 years old, with short wavy black hair and subtle stubble. He wears a navy overshirt over a plain white shirt and sits on a wooden chair in a simple gray-walled studio. Show him waist-up, facing the camera with a neutral expression, with his face large enough to inspect clearly. A large window is on camera left. Lighting is flat indirect neutral daylight. Use a natural photographic rendering with a clearly resolved face and a gently defocused background. Keep the composition simple and suitable for subsequent lighting-only edits with unchanged framing. No text, logos, or watermark.
source.nature: AI 生成的虚构成年人像，并非真人实拍

achieved: 生成了明确要求为虚构合成的成年东亚男性半身人像。
方形画面、深蓝外衫、白色内搭、木椅、左侧窗户与灰墙均可见。
表情中性、正面朝向，脸部细节清晰，背景略虚化。
deviations: 画面右后方额外出现木桌与植物，并非提示词要求的物体。
日光虽平缓，仍有可见左侧方向性；不是完全均匀的照明。
observations.identity_pose_drift: 不适用：这是共同输入基线。

runs.prompt:
EDIT: relight-and-skin; preserve source identity, geometry, expression, pose, viewpoint, framing, focal plane, and depth of field.
LIGHT: A broad upper-left window creates neutral soft light and gradual falloff across the person and wall. Retain highlight headroom, readable midtones, directional shadows, and a stable black point; allow faint room bounce and one continuous soft window shadow.
SKIN: Use luminous source complexion, broad bounded highlights, and faint focus-aware regional detail.
AVOID: pasted shadows and plastic gloss.
runs.label: 柔和窗光
runs.title: 柔和窗光：变化细微，窗影不明确
runs.verdict: 部分达成 · 窗影不明确
runs.goal: 让左前上方的宽大窗光照亮人物与墙面，保留柔和明暗过渡，并产生一条连续窗影。
runs.observation: 左侧柔光与自然肤色保留，脸部和墙面较基线略明亮。 肤质未见明显塑料光泽，主体衣物的暗部仍可辨。
runs.limitations: 变化幅度较小，光线仍较平；一条连续柔和窗影未能清楚辨认。 灰墙照明较均匀，提示词要求的渐进衰减不十分突出。 肉眼未见明显身份、表情或坐姿变化。头发轮廓、衣褶及脸部纹理存在轻微重绘差异；不构成像素级几何保持证明。

runs.prompt:
EDIT: relight-and-skin; preserve source identity, geometry, expression, pose, viewpoint, framing, focal plane, and depth of field.
LIGHT: Warm side-rear sunset light outlines hair and shoulders. Protect sunset highlights, let unlit facial midtones fall naturally, retain directional shadows and a clean black point, and add one faint source-aligned flare with no frontal fill.
RENDER: Use restrained editorial color and smooth digital highlight roll-off.
SKIN: Keep continuous complexion and faint detail only on resolved illuminated planes.
AVOID: frontal fill and orange skin wash.
runs.label: 夕阳逆光
runs.title: 夕阳逆光：轮廓光出现了，暗侧够暗吗？
runs.verdict: 轮廓光明显 · 曝光约束未确认
runs.goal: 让暖色侧后光勾勒头发与肩膀，优先保留夕阳高光，不添加正面补光，并让未受光的面部自然变暗。
runs.observation: 头发及肩部出现显著金色侧后轮廓光，窗边呈现暖色日落气氛。 左侧背景可见柔和圆形耀斑；大部分面部肤色仍接近自然，未被全面橙染。
runs.limitations: 脸部正面中间调依然明亮，不能确认满足 no frontal fill。 窗外和光源附近出现接近白色的高亮区域，不能声称高光余量完全保留。 肩部轮廓光较强且两肩均显著受光，克制程度有限。 整体身份、表情、朝向和坐姿肉眼接近基线；细节有重绘，无像素配准或身份相似度量化验证。

runs.prompt:
EDIT: relight-and-skin; preserve source identity, geometry, expression, pose, viewpoint, framing, focal plane, and depth of field.
LIGHT: Separate a magenta key from a cyan rim; preserve a natural skin zone. Hold shaped highlights, selected facial midtones, directional deep shadows, and a clean black point. Restrict subtle bokeh to the already defocused background.
RENDER: Keep controlled cool ambience and smooth digital highlights without a global tint.
SKIN: Use continuous source complexion with restrained available-light reflections and focus-limited detail.
AVOID: colored skin wash and foreground bokeh.
runs.label: 双色霓虹
runs.title: 双色霓虹：轮廓分色成功，主光没有跟上
runs.verdict: 双色轮廓形成 · 主光未充分实现
runs.goal: 使用品红主光和青色轮廓光，保留部分自然肤色，形成方向明确的深阴影与低调曝光。
runs.observation: 画面左侧洋红光与右侧青色轮廓光明显分离，灰墙转为冷色氛围。 脸部中心保留自然肤色，衣物仍有深色区域；未见前景散景点。
runs.limitations: 洋红光主要落在头发、面部边缘与肩部，脸部中央仍像中性主光，magenta key 未充分实现。 面部深阴影较弱，整体正面仍明亮。 背景未见明确新增散景亮斑；其虚化程度只可作肉眼判断。 肉眼未见明显身份或姿态漂移，裁切与头部位置基本一致；细部重绘存在，未进行几何量化。
